units.title: Hallo! Erste Kontakte
units.description: Greet people, introduce yourself, say where you live and ask simple questions.
units.cultureNote: Germans distinguish informal 'du' and formal 'Sie'. When in doubt, use 'Sie' with adults you don't know — switching to 'du' is offered, not assumed.

units.title: Menschen und Dinge
units.description: Talk about people and everyday things: articles and gender, plurals, having things, and saying no.
units.cultureNote: German nouns are always capitalized — readers rely on it. Learning each noun with its article (der/die/das) from day one pays off for years.
